draft_en.subject: Re: 16 Port Ethernet Switch
draft_en.body:
Hello Markus,

In June 2025 you asked two things about the DIN-rail copper switches - the purchase quantities and the price for the 8-port and 24-port units. We sent you the full list but never answered the quantity question properly - apologies, here it is.

- Quantities: MOQ is 1 unit. Samples and small lots are fine; larger lots get a quantity price on request.
- 8 x Gigabit DIN-rail, 12-58 V DC, -40 to 75 C, unmanaged - model STI-080GE - $31.4 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); it was $32.5 on the June-2025 list.
- 24 x Gigabit DIN-rail unmanaged - model STI-0240GE - $130 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity), built to order, 4-7 working days.
- 8 x Gigabit PoE+ DIN-rail unmanaged, in case PoE is the version you meant - model STI-088GP - $42.2 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity).

CE/RoHS, 3-year warranty. If these are for your own-brand range (DEMA / Fix Aktiv): the logo on the unit is free; a colour box is available from 200 sets.

One question: is the switch for your own-brand range in the Stabilo stores and web shops, or for an installation of your own? That decides whether I send the own-label sample or the plain one.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
